name: PIC-v1

instruction_ledger.owned_explanatory_asm: CALL 0x108 ; encoded word address, PCLATH context required

references.snippet:
define space CODE type=ram_space wordsize=2 size=2 default;

# General Purpose Register Memory consists of 4-banks of 255-bytes for PIC16,
# or 32-banks of 255 bytes each for PIC_16F.
# Bank selection occurs using STATUS register bits RP0 & RP1
define space DATA type=ram_space size=2; 

# HWSTACK consists of a 8-word by 13-bit RAM and a corresponding to a hidden stack pointer (STKPTR).
define space HWSTACK type=ram_space wordsize=2 size=1;  # WORDSIZE is actually 13-bits

limits: CODE declares wordsize=2; DATA and HWSTACK are distinct spaces. Preserve both Java offset getters when eventually run.

CALL operand combines PCLATH<4:3> and k11; proposed low-word target 0x108 requires explicit PCLATH=0 context. Selected source uses call [absAddr11], so a direct static target is NOT currently promised.
BTFSS uses possibleSkip/SkipNext propagation; isolate-only decoding is insufficient for conditional coverage. No PIC16F relative BRA substituted for selected PIC_16.
